scope: Conflicting or duplicate framing headers that make front-end and back-end parsers disagree on request boundaries.
exclusions: Header value injection with no framing conflict belongs to crlf_header_injection
Text templates for HTTP/2 with no raw frame fixture
required_evidence: Exact raw framing with duplicate or conflicting Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding
Parser-stack assumptions for front-end and back-end
benign_counterexamples: Proxy request with a single valid Content-Length header
Client chunked upload that sends only Transfer-Encoding chunked
note: Seeded payload lists already cover single payload strings; write whole application scenarios instead (route, parameter, sink context), with realistic payloads of this class, at most ceil(count/families) records per family.
